entries.title: Warehouse Sorting Robots on a Conveyor Grid
entries.description: A light-colored warehouse floor with multiple cube-bodied robots sliding on a grid of lanes, picking up colored boxes from moving conveyors, avoiding collisions, and dropping them into labeled bins that fill, glow briefly on successful delivery, and show trails of past robot paths.

entries.title: Robot Arm Assembly Line with Swappable Tools
entries.description: A stationary robotic arm with rotating joints and interchangeable colored tool-heads (gripper, welder, screwdriver) that attach/detach from a tool rack to manipulate small parts on a moving belt, with sparks particles for welding and transparent overlays highlighting active joints.
entries.seed: Robot Arm Assembly Line with Swappable Tools: A stationary robotic arm with rotating joints and interchangeable colored tool-heads (gripper, welder, screwdriver) that attach/detach from a tool rack to manipulate small parts on a moving belt, with sparks particles for welding and transparent overlays highlighting active joints.

entries.title: Swarm Cleaning Micro-Robots on a Glass Wall
entries.description: Dozens of tiny disc-shaped micro-robots crawling on a large vertical transparent pane, leaving fading blue trails where they “clean,” clustering around dirt spots that dissolve as they scrub, and occasionally bouncing off each other while a side meter tracks cleaned area.

entries.title: Robot Soccer Match with Strategy Zones
entries.description: A bright rectangular field with two teams of wheeled robots (red vs blue) chasing a white ball that bounces and rolls, with robots coordinating passes, avoiding collisions, taking shots on goal, and leaving short motion trails plus score labels above each goal.

entries.title: Humanoid Robots Training on an Obstacle Course
entries.description: Several simplified humanoid robots running, jumping, and balancing across platforms, ramps, and rotating beams, with some falling and colliding, others successfully crossing and triggering glowing checkpoints and floating performance labels above each robot.
